analysis_policy.application_ratio: paired Refact/Ours ratio of complete per-step application time; refresh and reset work included
analysis_policy.confidence_intervals: two-sided Student-t 95% intervals across ten paired seeds with df=9
analysis_policy.core_normalization: each method's total non-refresh core seconds divided by its own steps minus refresh_count; paired Refact/Ours ratios are then summarized across seeds
analysis_policy.test_policy: one terminal test evaluation per method per pair after both trainings; no test-based selection
